title: Balance & Bite's Thai Beef Salad
ingredients: Protein & Base: 300g scotch fillet steak, 100g cooked vermicelli noodles, 1/2 cup white rice
Salad: 1 cos lettuce head (torn), 2 punnet cherry tomatoes (halved), 1/2 bunch Thai basil, Vietnamese mint & coriander
Dressing: 2 limes (juiced), 1/4 cup fish sauce, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 green chillies, 1 garlic clove
Pantry: 1 tbsp olive oil, salt and pepper
steps: Toast rice in a small frypan over medium-high heat for 3-5 min until golden, then cool and grind into a coarse powder.
Heat a dry frypan over high heat. Season steak with salt, pepper and olive oil, then sear 2-3 min per side and rest.
Grind garlic and chillies into a paste, then mix with lime juice, fish sauce and sugar to create the dressing.
Toss lettuce, noodles, tomatoes and herbs in a large bowl, then top with thinly sliced rested steak.
Drizzle with dressing, scatter with toasted rice powder, and serve immediately with extra lime and chilli.
